reconcile.note: Gill distinguishes the common scented oil Proverbs praises from the one sacred anointing recipe Exodus reserves solely for the Tabernacle.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells frames Exodus's ban on copying the sacred incense recipe as a flat prohibition of perfume, set directly against Proverbs' praise of it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: The incense which you shall make, according to its composition you shall not make for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.
sides.verseText: The incense which you shall make, according to its composition you shall not make for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.

sides.snippet: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; So does earnest counsel from a man's friend.
sides.verseText: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; So does earnest counsel from a man's friend.
